Hi Stefan,

This is almost certainly not your mistake. The checkout's address check often rejects the Australian "(address hidden)" style for unit numbers.

Try splitting it up. Put "(address hidden)" in the street address line and "(address hidden)" in the apartment line. Then enter (address hidden) as the suburb, NSW as the state and (postcode hidden) as the postcode.

If the same message still appears, a colleague is already looking into it today and will get back to you with an answer. You don't need to send anything again.

Best regards,
Sarah

Am 11/11/2026 um 00:31 schrieb Sarah — HeliumDeploy Support <(email hidden)>:

Stefan's checkout problem seems resolved, so I didn't raise another flag. I ran a test checkout to his German address, and it requested a phone number before offering shipping, which aligns with the error he described. I tested this with a Thor P2 because I am unsure which product he wants. Here is my reply:

---

Hi Stefan,

Thank you for the new address, and apologies that my last email reached you with some of my working notes at the top.

I ran a test checkout to (address hidden), (address hidden). Shipping options would not appear until a phone number was entered, which is very likely the message you kept seeing. At checkout, set the country to Germany, enter the address, and add a current phone number. A German number is preferable if you have one now. Shipping options should then become available.

Regarding your other question, orders to Germany ship from our warehouse in the Netherlands rather than the US. Consequently, there is no import VAT, duty, or customs charge to pay on delivery. If you inform me which miner you are seeking, I will confirm this for that model and provide its ship date.

Best regards,
Sarah J. reply to this email and it will come straight to us.

﻿
I've flagged the checkout problem to the team. Here's my reply to Stefan:

---

Hi Stefan,

Thanks for the screenshot. It shows this isn't your mistake, and your German address is fine. The problem is on our side. The Miner D. in your cart works out its shipping cost differently from the miner, and for Germany that calculation isn't returning a price. That blocks shipping for the whole order. Please try the Bitfortun BS-4 on its own, without the Duster, and shipping should appear. A colleague is also checking this today and will get back to you.

On the warehouse, I need to correct my last email. The BS-4 isn't held in our European warehouse. It ships from the manufacturer by November 30, 2026. Shipping to Germany is customs and duties prepaid, so there's nothing to pay when it's delivered.

Sorry as well that my earlier emails reached you with some internal notes at the top.

Best regards,
Sarah

Sarah
